mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months indicates active monetary easing, reducing discount rates for equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in >55% of instances with declining FEDFUNDS, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 5.0% in a 3-month window signals labor market deterioration that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in >55% of instances with UNRATE > 5.0, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in FEDFUNDS and rise in CPIAUCSL indicates monetary policy response to inflation, triggering short-term equity market rallies due to anticipated economic stabilization over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Interaction term effect is insignificant (p>0.05) in regression of 20-day returns, or Rank IC < 0.02 for interaction signal over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion regimes, rising residential construction (HOUST) signals sustained consumer spending momentum that drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in >55% of late-cycle expansions with rising HOUST, or Rank IC < 0.02 for HOUST in late-cycle regimes.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) over 6 months indicates robust manufacturing activity that supports corporate earnings growth, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in >55% of instances with rising INDPRO, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Real personal consumption (RSAFS) falling below 700,000 million dollars in a 3-month window signals sharp consumer spending slowdown, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in >55% of instances with RSAFS < 700000, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In high-unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 5.0%), rising labor force participation (PAYEMS) signals improving job market conditions that boost consumer confidence and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in >55% of instances with UNRATE > 5.0 and rising PAYEMS, or Rank IC < 0.02 for PAYEMS in high-unemployment regimes.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) falling below 100 in a 3-month window signals manufacturing slowdown that reduces corporate profits, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in >55% of instances with INDPRO < 100, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.
